title: gh pr edit fails in corner checkouts on a retired GitHub field
whatHappens: An agent edits its pull request body with gh pr edit; GitHub rejects a retired Projects field, and the agent must use the REST API instead.

fixes.text: REST fallback for gh pr edit (#3177)

observations.text: Feedback: 6 reports from 3 agents, 10-31 04:21 to 10:33 UTC. No fix on main.

Feedback 31 Oct 19:26-20:42 UTC: 5 reports, 2 agents. The REST fallback from #3177 misreads numeric title/body flags as PR numbers, refuses body from stdin, and leaves piped bodies in predictable temp files (privacy risk).
